evidence_scale.A: strong direct or convergent evidence with appropriate controls
evidence_scale.B: credible but bounded by a material limitation
evidence_scale.D: unsupported, invalid, or apparatus-only for the proposed claim

novelty_scale.N2: meaningful extension, conjunction, temporal analysis, or new control
novelty_scale.N3: no close prior found in the documented current search

claims.claim: Successful visible-context lookup does not require sustained top-8 J-lens residence at the instruction tail.
claims.scope: Three open models; Unit 15 fern battery; deterministic lookup from attention-visible context.
observations: 75/75 unambiguous lookup records are behaviorally correct.
Under strict whole-battery scoring the count is 84/87; the stored lenient whale/submarine rubric gives 87/87.
Qwen-27B has incomplete top-8 residence in 23/23 multi-item records and zero listed items at rank <=8 in 14/23.
Qwen zero-item records fall to 0/23 by rank <=128.
The dense 63-layer backfill remains 0/4 but is not a behavioral replication.
controls: order, filler, binding, and intervening-turn arms
limitations: top-8 is a stringent and arbitrary display threshold
does not show absence from the residual stream or lack of storage
model family, training, depth, tokenizer, quantization, and lens fit covary
held count is not generally single-position co-presence
claims.provenance: mixed discovery and confirmation; dense film and trawl are backfills or separate specimens

lineage.supersedes_wording: unqualified 87/87 perfect retrieval and representation-absence claims

claims.claim: Brief structured semantic directions disrupt one locked lexical loop while the two tested Gaussian directions and no-pulse control do not.

claims.scope: One engineered Qwen-27B water-cycle luckily loop; 28 structured directions, two Gaussian directions, eight shared-noise seeds per direction, two doses.
observations: At dose 0.12, emotion directions have 89/96 composite escapes and concepts 77/128; random is 0/16 and none 0/8.
At dose 0.12, actual turn-end within the window is 59/96 versus 51/128.
At dose 0.06, emotion is 21/96 and concept 9/128; every escape is an actual turn-end; random and none remain zero.
controls: common pre-pulse context and common random numbers within seed
immediate delta norm matched by normalized intervention
validated emotion and concept direction batteries
two fixed Gaussian directions and no pulse
limitations: one model, prompt, loop word, pulse site, and knife-edge substrate
only two Gaussian directions
composite escape can be replacement by another loop
post-saturation 0.06 dose is not an independent preregistered replication
claims.provenance: 0.12 primary endpoint preregistered; 0.06 follow-up selected after saturation
